snippet.title: DOPAMINER - Reveal trailer
snippet.description:
DOPAMINER is an incremental mining game where you play as a goblin obsessed with hoarding precious gems and unique artifacts. Use your jetpack to fly through the mine and your magical staff to shoot and blow up everything in your path in the pursuit of the biggest haul possible.

WISHLIST ON STEAM! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2614840/DOPAMINER/

Early demo available on itch.io. 
https://comboi-studios.itch.io/dopaminer-demo

Playtest coming soon on Steam.

--------------------------------------------------
Official Music Credit:
Music: "Challenge Accepted" By HeatleyBros 
https://youtu.be/UHClzbbpTds?si=gS20T5C5YWum3Cme
